proves.claim: checkHidesResult is true for a check that sends its output to /dev/null or masks its exit, and false for a plain node test-runner command over named test files.

cli.logic-check-shape.flags-hidden-outpu.why: Without it a check that can never fail would be claimed and pass the gate unproven.

proves.claim: with claim.checkCeiling on, claim refuses CHECK_UNSOUND for a check that hides its output or masks its exit, before any baseline is read, leaving the item open and unclaimed.

cli.io-claim.check-shape-refuses-hidden.why: Without it an item whose check can never show a failure is claimed and built for nothing.

proves.claim: with claim.checkCeiling off or unset, an item whose check hides its output is claimed as today.

cli.io-claim.check-shape-claims-when-off.why: Without it the new refusal would change claims on boards that did not opt in.
